subject.title: No migration path or warning when a model provider id is removed/renamed (openai-codex -> openai): OAuth profiles silently orphaned

question: Should Nix-mode `doctor --fix` be allowed to run non-config auth/session repairs and fail only at actual `openclaw.json` writes?
rationale: Current source and docs still enforce a broad fail-fast Nix policy, while the linked issue and PR argue for a narrower policy boundary; automation should not choose that product/upgrade contract alone.

options.title: Allow Non-Config Repairs
options.body: Land or replace the linked Nix-mode PR so auth-profile and session-state doctor repairs can run while actual config writes remain guarded.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed Nix Mode
options.body: Reject the carve-out and close this issue as documented Nix behavior, accepting that Nix users must use external/manual recovery for these repairs.

options.title: Split Auth-Only Recovery
options.body: Keep doctor fail-closed but add a separate explicitly safe auth/session repair command for Nix-managed installs.

recommendation.title: Allow Non-Config Repairs
recommendation.body: Land or replace the linked Nix-mode PR so auth-profile and session-state doctor repairs can run while actual config writes remain guarded.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current Nix-mode write-guard policy and are the clearest history owner for whether that policy should be narrowed.
